notes:
No authorial page number appears at the top. The thin lower-left foliation is 51, matching H’s archive page for scan 52. The sheet continues with homéomorphismes universels and proposes faithfulness, and perhaps full faithfulness after localization, for an étale-topos construction. Its final example concerns exterior automorphisms and a structure à lacets. These are the author’s claims, not results checked in this reading. The marginal S de car. 0 ? is the author’s own question and belongs beside the given base S. The first base-topos letter is visibly X_et; the later one is S_et. The discrepancy is preserved rather than repaired from the surrounding scheme notation. The first functor shaft retains a dash/arrow doubt, and it has no left mapsto bar. In f,g:X=Y the two short unheaded strokes are transcribed literally as =, whereas the subsequent X_et-to-Y_et pair has visible arrowheads. The short sign after et is also literally =, consistent with the run’s unexpanded shorthand for même. The two réduits occupy different raised locations: the cancelled one is above finie–sur, and the live replacement has a leader after des schémas. The inserted f_et,g_et retain uncertainty over tiny lettering as well as their attachment, which is not fixed by a leader; the primary placement follows de topos. The small ég/fg mark before isomorphes remains uncertain both in lettering and in deletion state. The first-phase crop clipped the subscript f descender. The extended blind-audit crop now shows the complete formula and resolves l.t.f without a terminal stop; the historical first-phase crop is unchanged. The article les/le and following suivants/suivant both retain local terminal-stroke doubts. The experimental verb and the verb after inserted re retain full word-ending alternatives; the en/on doubt and raised prefix re are treated separately from those suffix doubts. Three autom occurrences and hom are dotless. Literal double ticks surround fait. The script E_K is an alphabet-only correction. The looped-l word lacets and the tiny accented à before it are retained without expansion or normalization. Provient is live despite retracing of its initial strokes. No final full stop is supplied after X. The line count covers 21 main baseline lines, five raised or marginal writing runs, and the foliation entry. No other page or return was inspected, and no mathematical proof check was performed.

[Blind audit] All six differing crops were inspected. The introductory short form is schém., not expanded schéma. The article before foncteur and the noun itself remain le foncteur: their terminal returns do not supply distinct additional s bodies. The full X-to-X_et connector remains doubtful with a headless shaft first; the cancelled raised réduits stays physically above finie–sur, distinct from the curved leader of the live replacement. Both the first X=Y and the shorthand after et retain their clear two-bar readings; the subsequent topoi pair alone has explicit heads. The dot in soient supports the retained form against blind sont. The tiny added labels remain uncertain under the existing wrapper, and the ég/fg fragment retains its lettering/state alternatives. The extended Sch formula resolves l.t.f without a terminal point; a separate comma after fractions is restored. Exprimant becomes the primary experimental verb, with the longer alternative retained. En gains on, and trouverait becomes the primary baseline verb ending, without grammatical completion. The low foliation is 51; its margin wrapper already existed in the page, so the blind wrapper difference changes no text. No mathematical verification was performed.
